active_family: 309 learned center plus vanilla residual flow
current_bottleneck: Replacing the diagonal shell with a joint residual flow fixed the small-move and jump-scale collapse, but the model still spreads mass in the wrong places: some cells remain severely miscalibrated, unconditional level distributions drift, and cross-cell dependence is still slightly too weak once residual diversity is added on top of the deterministic center.
last_result_summary: 309a-v0 kept the learned deterministic 289c center and replaced the coarse shell with a vanilla joint residual transition flow. It still scored 2/11, but materially changed the profile: h1 coverage rose to 86.5%, daily-change KS passed at 16/25, move-size profile passed 4/4, jump q90/q99 ratios passed, and mean-reversion active cells reached 18/24. Remaining failures are concentrated in per-cell coverage imbalance, level KS drift, regime differentiation, and cross-cell corr ratio just below gate at 0.492.
next_step_recommendation: Run post-experiment analysis next. Determine whether 309a is mostly a dispersion-calibration problem around an otherwise correct residual law, or whether the remaining level-drift and correlation weakness imply a deeper mismatch in the residual parameterization. Do not add shell-style knobs back in.
